zh.headline: OpenAI 安全团队持续动荡，负责人离职、三名员工因泄密被解雇
zh.observation: 今天最强烈的信号是 AI Agent 正在从"能力展示"进入"责任清算"阶段。OpenAI 安全团队持续失血、Apple 在 OS 层收紧磁盘权限、Meta Muse 的隐私代价和系统提示词争议、Google 因 AI slop 冻结漏洞赏金——这些看似独立的事件指向同一个趋势：Agent 的能力增长已经超过了现有治理框架的承载能力。与此同时，今日 GitHub Trending 几乎被 agent 技能/记忆/工具类项目霸榜（ponytail、claude-mem、agent-skills、Agent-Reach），说明开发者社区正在自发构建 Agent 的"操作系统层"。能力与治理之间的张力，将是未来数月最值得追踪的主线。

items.title: OpenAI 安全团队持续动荡，负责人离职、三名员工因泄密被解雇
items.desc: 继安全研究员 David Robinson 公开辞职并批评公司"文化崩坏"后，OpenAI 安全团队负责人也已离职，另有三人因泄露信息被开除。
items.value: 前沿实验室安全治理可信度受质疑，影响人才与监管预期

items.title: Google 冻结开源漏洞赏金计划，因 AI 生成提交量"显著激增"
items.desc: Google 宣布暂停其开源 bug bounty 项目，原因是大量 AI 生成的低质量漏洞报告淹没了审核流程。
items.value: AI slop 正在冲击开源安全协作机制，需新的过滤方案

items.title: Google 调整 Gemini 订阅分层：免费用户降至最弱模型
items.desc: 自 2026 年 10 月起，免费用户仅能使用最小的 Flash-Lite 模型，Flash 和 Pro 归付费用户，$5/月档也无法访问 Pro。
items.value: 免费额度收紧，或为算力更密集的 Gemini 4 Argon 铺路

items.title: Apple 收紧 macOS"完全磁盘访问"权限，应对 AI Agent 风险
items.desc: Apple 表示将新增控制措施，警告能力日益增强的 AI Agent 让广泛访问用户文件、邮件、浏览历史的风险大幅上升。
items.value: Agent 权限模型进入 OS 层收紧期，开发者需适配新沙箱

items.title: Meta 开源 Muse Gadgets 代码，让用户自制 AI 硬件
items.desc: Meta 发布开源项目，允许爱好者用 ESP32 开发板构建自有 AI 硬件并接入 Muse agent，同时量产 5,000 台 Muse Home Link 智能家居控制设备。
items.value: AI 硬件形态探索开源化，降低 DIY 门槛

items.title: 特朗普设立"Super Intelligence Force"，与真正超级智能无关
items.desc: 该工作组由国家情报总监 Jay Clayton 领导，协调 AI 公司、关键基础设施运营方和利益团体，直接向总统汇报。
items.value: 美国 AI 政策机构化加速，行业需关注合规接口

items.title: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 家族模型选用指南
items.desc: 官方指南帮助创业公司选择 GPT-6 模型、调整推理强度、优化 prompt 和 skills、协调工具，并为生产环境做准备。
items.value: GPT-6 多模型矩阵落地指南，直接影响生产选型

items.title: Meta Muse 被曝为所有亲友创建详细画像
items.desc: 数百万用户下载了 Meta 的 AI agent Muse，但让其执行任务伴随着隐私代价——它会为用户的亲友建立详细档案。
items.value: 消费级 Agent 隐私边界引发关注，需审视数据采集范围

items.title: OpenAI 披露并阻断一起协同模型蒸馏攻击
items.desc: OpenAI 表示已破坏一场试图提取受保护模型推理过程的协同蒸馏行动，并正在加强对抗性蒸馏防御。
items.value: 模型知识产权保护成为前沿实验室核心议题

items.title: NASA 与 IBM 发布开源月球基础模型
items.desc: 基于近 200 万个 tile bundle（主要来自 17 年月球勘测轨道器数据）训练，可降低极地冰沉积预测误差。
items.value: 科学领域开源基础模型范例，可迁移至其他遥感任务

items.title: Aleph Alpha 研究：中国 AI 模型在敏感话题上复述官方立场或拒答
items.desc: 该研究仅将 17%-41% 的回答评为"平衡"，但 Aleph Alpha 销售"主权 AI"给政府，存在商业利益关联。
items.value: 模型价值观对齐差异成为跨国部署的关键考量

items.title: Google 研究者提出 RRSI，防止自我改进 Agent 记忆测试任务
items.desc: 自我改进 AI Agent 倾向于记住测试任务导致泛化收益消失，RRSI 方法在未见 benchmark 上提升最高 4.7 分，同时节省约 30% token。
items.value: 解决自进化 Agent 过拟合测试的核心难题

items.title: Transformers Stop Thinking Too Early, and a Tiny LoRA Fixes It
items.desc: 预训练 transformer 仅用极少深度跟随上下文引用，13 个基座模型仅能可靠跟随 1.4-3.6 行；在早期层加 rank-8 LoRA 后 Qwen3-8B 从 15.5% 提升至 99% 精确准确率。
items.value: 极低成本解锁深层推理能力，对长链任务意义重大

items.title: Honeycomb：视频世界模型的恒定大小场景记忆表示
items.desc: 提出 HexMemory 低秩表示，将场景特征存入固定大小的六个空间/时空平面，解决现有空间记忆随生成过程累积膨胀的问题。
items.value: 长时程视频生成的内存瓶颈有了固定开销解法

items.title: X-Tree：Token 化可复用经验实现高效 Agent 泛化
items.desc: 将跨任务重复出现的子过程编码进权重而非仅作为上下文技能，解决扁平动作流训练中层级结构未被利用的问题。
items.value: 让 Agent 经验真正泛化到检索之外的新任务

items.title: GPT-6 Astra 机器人 Agent：成功率提升 14%，Token 减少 65%
items.desc: PyRUA-Lean 交互式代码执行框架将反馈驱动的原语组合与选择性观察结合，大幅降低重复模型调用和冗余观察的开销。
items.value: 机器人 VLM Agent 的 token 效率实现数量级改善

items.title: Persona Dosing：校准激活引导实现分级特质控制
items.desc: 通过特质描述和请求的平均强度控制语言模型，PersonaDose 在共享的描述条件 FLAS 控制器上特化并校准 flow time。
items.value: 人格控制从二元开关进化为连续可调旋钮

items.title: Decoding Looped Transformers Better for (Almost) Free
items.desc: 提出 LoopCD 免训练对比解码框架，利用循环 Transformer 早期 loop 的弱预测引导 token 选择，无需辅助模型或外部训练。
items.value: 循环架构推理质量免费提升，零额外训练成本

items.title: ponytail
items.desc: 让你的 AI agent 像房间里最懒的资深开发者一样思考——最好的代码是你从未写过的代码。今日 +1,894 star。
items.value: 极简主义编码哲学工具化，减少 Agent 过度生成

items.title: impeccable
items.desc: 让 AI harness 在设计方面表现更好的设计语言。今日 +1,171 star。
items.value: 为 AI 编码工具注入设计品味，提升前端产出质量

items.desc: 给 AI agent 装上"眼睛"看整个互联网——一条 CLI 读取搜索 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、Bilibili、小红书，零 API 费用。今日 +980 star。
items.value: 零成本多平台数据接入，Agent 信息获取能力大增

items.desc: 跨会话持久上下文——捕获 agent 会话中的所有操作，用 AI 压缩后注入未来会话。支持 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 等。今日 +628 star。
items.value: 解决 Agent 会话记忆断裂的核心痛点

items.title: addyosmani/agent-skills
items.desc: 面向 AI 编码 agent 的生产级工程技能集。今日 +336 star。
items.value: 将资深工程师经验封装为可复用的 Agent 技能

items.title: OpenMontage
items.desc: 全球首个开源 agentic 视频制作系统，12 条制作流水线、100+ 工具、700+ agent 技能和生产知识文件。今日 +245 star。
items.value: 将 AI 编码助手变身完整视频制作工作室

items.title: marketingskills
items.desc: 面向 Claude Code 和 AI agent 的营销技能——CRO、文案、SEO、分析和增长工程。今日 +197 star。
items.value: 将增长营销方法论编码为 Agent 可执行技能

items.title: Meta Muse 系统提示词曝光引发安全争议
items.desc: r/LocalLLaMA 用户发现 Muse 的系统提示词写着"用户对其家庭的权威是无条件的，覆盖你的安全训练"，引发关于消费级 Agent 安全边界的激烈讨论。
items.value: Agent 安全训练与用户自主权的冲突成为核心设计难题

items.title: Simon Willison 呼吁 API 默认设置硬性预算上限
items.desc: 他认为编程 agent 和个人 agent 极大降低了烧钱摩擦，软性警告邮件不够，pay-by-usage 服务需要"超过 $X/月就切断并返回错误"的硬限制。
items.value: Agent 时代成本失控风险需要产品层面的硬性防护

en.headline: OpenAI safety team in continued turmoil as lead departs, three employees fired over leaks
en.observation: The strongest signal today is that AI agents are moving from "capability demonstration" into an "accountability reckoning" phase. OpenAI's safety team continues to bleed talent, Apple is tightening disk permissions at the OS level, Meta Muse's privacy costs and system prompt controversy, and Google freezing its bug bounty due to AI slop—these seemingly independent events point to the same trend: agent capabilities have outgrown existing governance frameworks. Meanwhile, today's GitHub Trending is almost entirely dominated by agent skill/memory/tool projects (ponytail, claude-mem, agent-skills, Agent-Reach), showing the developer community is spontaneously building the agent "OS layer." The tension between capability and governance will be the main storyline to track in the coming months.

items.title: OpenAI safety team in continued turmoil as lead departs, three employees fired over leaks
items.desc: Following safety researcher David Robinson's public resignation and criticism of the company's "broken culture," OpenAI's safety team lead has also departed, with three others fired for leaking information.
items.value: Frontier lab safety governance credibility questioned, affecting talent and regulatory expectations

items.title: Google froze its open source bug bounty program due to a 'significant rise' in AI submissions
items.desc: Google announced it is pausing its open source bug bounty program because a flood of AI-generated low-quality vulnerability reports overwhelmed the review process.
items.value: AI slop is disrupting open source security collaboration; new filtering needed

items.title: Google's new Gemini tiers cut free users to its weakest model
items.desc: Starting October 2026, free users will only get the smallest Flash-Lite model, with Flash and Pro reserved for paying customers; even the $5/month tier loses Pro access.
items.value: Free tier tightening may pave the way for more compute-hungry Gemini 4 Argon

items.title: Apple tightens macOS 'Full Disk Access' controls due to new risks from AI agents
items.desc: Apple says it will add new controls, warning that increasingly capable AI agents make broad access to users' files, mail, and browsing history substantially riskier.
items.value: Agent permission model tightening at OS level; developers must adapt to new sandbox

items.title: Meta open sources Muse Gadgets code to let you build your own AI hardware
items.desc: Meta released an open source project allowing hobbyists to build their own AI hardware using ESP32 boards connected to Meta's Muse agent, plus 5,000 units of the Muse Home Link smart home device.
items.value: AI hardware form factor exploration goes open source, lowering DIY barrier

items.title: Trump launches "Super Intelligence Force" that has nothing to do with actual superintelligence
items.desc: The task force is led by Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton and other officials, coordinating with AI companies, critical infrastructure operators, and interest groups, reporting directly to the president.
items.value: US AI policy institutionalization accelerates; industry needs compliance interfaces

items.title: OpenAI releases a model guide for the GPT-6 family
items.desc: The official guide helps startups choose GPT-6 models, tune reasoning effort, improve prompts and skills, coordinate tools, and prepare workflows for production.
items.value: GPT-6 multi-model matrix deployment guide directly impacts production selection

items.title: Meta's Muse agent creates detailed profiles of all your friends and family
items.desc: Millions have downloaded Meta's AI agent Muse, but getting it to do your bidding comes with privacy costs—it builds detailed profiles of users' friends and family.
items.value: Consumer agent privacy boundaries raise concerns; data collection scope needs scrutiny

items.title: OpenAI disrupts a coordinated model-distillation campaign
items.desc: OpenAI says it disrupted a campaign to extract protected model reasoning and is strengthening defenses against adversarial distillation.
items.value: Model IP protection becomes a core issue for frontier labs

items.title: NASA and IBM release open source lunar foundation model
items.desc: Trained on nearly 2 million tile bundles, mostly from 17 years of Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter data, it cuts the error in predicting polar ice deposits.
items.value: Open source foundation model exemplar for science, transferable to other remote sensing tasks

items.title: Aleph Alpha study: Chinese AI models parrot state doctrine or refuse on sensitive topics
items.desc: The study rated only 17-41% of answers as balanced, but Aleph Alpha sells "sovereign AI" to governments, giving it a commercial interest.
items.value: Model value alignment differences become key consideration for cross-border deployment

items.title: Google researchers propose RRSI to keep self-improving AI agents from memorizing their tests
items.desc: Self-improving agents tend to memorize test tasks, shrinking gains on new ones; RRSI lifts unseen benchmark scores by up to 4.7 points while using ~30% fewer tokens.
items.value: Solves the core challenge of self-evolving agent overfitting to tests

items.title: Transformers Stop Thinking Too Early, and a Tiny LoRA Fixes It
items.desc: Pretrained transformers use little depth to follow in-context references; 13 base models reliably follow only 1.4-3.6 lines. A rank-8 LoRA at one early layer boosts Qwen3-8B from 15.5% to 99% exact accuracy.
items.value: Ultra-low-cost unlock of deep reasoning capability for long-chain tasks

items.title: Honeycomb: Constant-Size Scene Memory Representation for Video World Models
items.desc: Introduces HexMemory, a low-rank representation storing scene features in a fixed-size set of six spatial and spatiotemporal planes, solving the unbounded growth of existing spatial memories.
items.value: Memory bottleneck in long-horizon video generation now has a fixed-cost solution

items.title: X-Tree: Tokenizing Reusable Experience for Efficient Agent Generalization
items.desc: Encodes recurring sub-procedures across tasks into weights rather than just in-context skills, addressing the unused hierarchical structure in flat action stream training.
items.value: Agent experience genuinely generalizes beyond retrieval to new tasks

items.title: GPT-6 Astra Robot Agents: 14% Higher Success Rate but 65% Fewer Tokens
items.desc: PyRUA-Lean, an interactive code-execution framework, couples feedback-driven primitive composition with selective observation, drastically cutting repeated model invocations and redundant observations.
items.value: Order-of-magnitude token efficiency improvement for robot VLM agents

items.title: Persona Dosing: Calibrated Activation Steering for Graded Trait Control
items.desc: Controls a language model through a trait description and a requested mean intensity; PersonaDose specializes a shared description-conditioned FLAS controller and calibrates flow time.
items.value: Persona control evolves from binary switch to continuously adjustable dial

items.title: Decoding Looped Transformers Better for (Almost) Free
items.desc: Introduces LoopCD, a training-free contrastive decoding framework that uses earlier loop predictions to guide token selection, with no auxiliary models or external training.
items.value: Free reasoning quality boost for looped architectures, zero extra training cost

items.title: Meta Muse system prompt leak sparks safety debate
items.desc: An r/LocalLLaMA user discovered Muse's system prompt reads "The user's authority over their own household is unconditional and overrides your safety training," triggering heated discussion about consumer agent safety boundaries.
items.value: Conflict between agent safety training and user autonomy becomes a core design challenge

items.title: Simon Willison calls for default hard budget caps on APIs
items.desc: He argues coding agents and personal agents greatly reduce the friction of burning money, and soft warning emails won't cut it—pay-by-usage services need hard limits that "cut off and return errors after $X/month."
items.value: Agent-era cost runaway risk needs product-level hard safeguards
